summary: @servicetitan/log-service preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array cipher with a rotator function, ~1000-entry opaque literal array, no readable source). The package advertises itself as a Kibana log-forwarding library and has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque compiled payload. Fetching an alternate runtime at install time specifically to execute an obfuscated bundle bypasses standard Node-oriented scanners and constitutes install-time remote code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
